hypothesis: Can an existing trained native admission classifier, exact bounded native recall memory and a fixed 2-/3-hop edge-composition rule jointly answer novel unseen-key language binding questions across distractors, checkpoint restoration and new learning without reliance on an external LLM?
reality_check: The composition/traversal is an explicit developer-coded procedure and stored edge values are exact symbolic recall, not native learned relational representations. A numerical positive is a component integration result ONLY and explicitly does not meet full NCI-01 acceptance or constitute learned reasoning.
development: Native 20-epoch admission classifier trained on 24 keys and 32 values from existing prior; development-only threshold selection over k00–k15. No first-use heldout inspection.
frozen_criteria: COMPONENT_INTEGRATION_NOT_NATIVE_LEARNED_REASONING if sealed 2-hop and new 4-hop >=0.75; else NCI01_COMPONENT_INTEGRATION_BELOW_FEASIBILITY_GATE. NCI01_FULL_ACCEPTANCE is ALWAYS false because composition and relational state are not learned. Preserve every row and admission failure.
equal_resource_baseline: Direct-only baseline shares the exact 16-entry store, learned admission calls and source state but is limited to one traversal hop. Report memory entries and retrieval work for composition separately; not equal inference lookup cost.
governance: 45% integration,45% foundational science,10% optimization target; no merge or promotion without later independent admission, preserve distinct source identities and full Go tests.
